battle.name: 十一月起義
battle.theater: 華沙近郊與維斯瓦河下游戰場
battle.brief: 一八三〇年十一月廿九日夜，華沙軍校學員與中尉在貝韋德爾宮發難，奪取軍火庫，會議王國的憲法與軍隊在一夜之間倒向起義者。沙皇拒絕一切讓步，戰事由華沙城郊打到奧斯特羅倫卡，最後以華沙陷落收場。野砲是波軍的骨幹，格羅霍夫一役波軍一百一十五門對俄軍一百七十八門。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 交戰的雙方是俄羅斯帝國與其治下的波蘭會議王國起義者。俄方以沙皇尼古拉一世為最高統帥，軍事指揮分兩段：一八三〇年冬由元帥迪比奇率領第一軍團集團自西面壓上，另有羅森、帕連等人指揮的軍團分進；一八三一年春，尼古拉一世改派帕斯克維奇接掌全軍，主力調度與戰術決策集中在他一人。波方是臨時政府領導的國民軍：亞當·耶日·恰爾托雷斯基主持外交，霍普伊茨基一度以獨裁者身份掌軍政，之後由斯克日涅茨基、德姆賓斯基、馬瓦霍夫斯基等人相繼接任；此外有維爾紐斯、明斯克等地的武裝志願者、艾米莉亞·普拉特率領的戰鐮隊，以及大批受徵召的鄉村武裝。普魯士依一八三〇年三月與俄國達成的協議，允許俄軍借道追擊越境者，是外部介入的關鍵一環。波蘭並未得到英法的實質援助，英法只停留在外交同情與招募志願者的層面，這種落差在半年之後變成波方最深的怨望。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Russian Empire and the insurgents of the Congress Kingdom of Poland under Russian rule. On the Russian side the tsar Nicholas I was the supreme commander, and command was exercised in two phases: in the winter of 1830 Field Marshal Diebitsch led the first group of corps in from the west, with other corps under such men as Rosen and Pahlen advancing separately; in the spring of 1831 Nicholas replaced him with Paskevich, who then held the concentration of the main body and the tactical decisions in his own hands. On the Polish side was the national army under the provisional government: Adam Jerzy Czartoryski handled foreign affairs, Józef Chłopicki presided over the army and the state for a time as dictator, and after him the command passed in turn to Skrzynecki, Dembiński and Małachowski. Alongside the regulars were armed volunteers in Vilnius, Minsk and other towns, the bands of war scythemen led by Emilia Plater, and large numbers of conscripted country levies. Prussia, by the agreement it had reached with Russia in March 1830, allowed Russian troops to cross its territory in pursuit of those who fled, and that was the hinge of the foreign intervention. Poland received no material help from Britain or France, which stayed at the level of diplomatic sympathy and the recruitment of volunteers, and that gap became the deepest grievance of the Polish side within six months.
people: 皮奧·維索斯基是起義的引爆者：一八三〇年十一月廿九日夜，他率領華沙軍事學校的學員與中尉奪取軍火庫、攻打康斯坦丁大公的貝韋德爾宮，兩天之內控制整座華沙。康斯坦丁大公是總督本人，平日更願與波蘭軍官合作而非鎮壓，起義爆發時他不在首都，這讓一夜得手成為可能。臨時政府成立後，恰爾托雷斯基主張談判，霍普伊茨基一度主持軍政，但軍方不滿其溫和，一八三一年一月他辭職，馬瓦霍夫斯基、斯克日涅茨基先後接掌軍權，兩派對「是談是打」的爭執貫穿始終，直接決定了每一輪軍事決策。炮兵是波軍真正的強項，伊格納齊·普拉德辛斯基以築城與火砲技術聞名，他設計的華沙防禦工事與火箭部署是波軍戰術的核心；約瑟夫·貝姆改進的康格里夫火箭在格羅霍夫用來對付俄軍騎兵衝鋒。俄方元帥迪比奇在格羅霍夫受挫後，由帕斯克維奇接手，他與沙皇都拒絕波蘭議會關於憲章的談判，最後由克魯科維茨基與帕斯克維奇簽下投降條約。盧維克·米哈伊·帕克是最後一任總司令，主持了華沙投降的談判；艾米莉亞·普拉特在立陶宛率戰鐮隊作戰，是起義中少數出身上層的著名女性指揮者。
peopleEn: Piotr Wysocki was the fuse of the uprising: on the night of 29 November 1830 he led the cadets and lieutenants of the Warsaw military school to seize the arsenal and to attack Grand Duke Constantine's Belweder Palace, and within two days the whole city was under their control. The grand duke was the viceroy himself and had always preferred to work with the Polish officer corps rather than crush it, and he was not in the capital when the revolt broke out, which made the overnight success possible. Once the provisional government was formed, Czartoryski argued for negotiation and Chłopicki presided over military and civil affairs for a time as dictator, but the officers were dissatisfied with his moderation and he resigned in January 1831; Małachowski and then Skrzynecki took over the command, and the quarrel between the moderate and the radical wing ran through the whole war, deciding every turn of the fighting. Artillery was the genuine strength of the Polish army: Ignacy Prądzyński was celebrated for his work on fortification and gunnery, and the Warsaw defences and rocket dispositions he designed were the core of Polish tactics; the Congreve rockets improved by Józef Bem were used at Grochów against Russian cavalry charges. On the Russian side, after Diebitsch was checked at Grochów, Paskevich took over, and he and the tsar both refused to negotiate with the Polish Diet over the charter, the capitulation eventually being signed by Krukowiecki and Paskevich. Ludwik Michał Pac, the last commander in chief, conducted the surrender negotiations for Warsaw; Emilia Plater led the scythemen in Lithuania and was one of the few well-known female commanders of the rising.
kits: 野砲在這場戰爭裡不是配角，而是波軍的骨幹。波蘭會議王國的炮兵以青銅滑膛砲為主，四磅、六磅、八磅與十二磅野砲配合三磅與五磅的曲射砲，另有團屬砲，總數在起義初期估計已有數百門。一八三一年二月二十五日奧耳伸卡－格羅霍夫之戰，波軍約三萬六千至四萬人、炮兵一百一十五門，俄軍約六萬人、炮兵一百七十八門，火力密度上俄軍佔優，但波軍把陣地佈在格羅霍夫以東的樹林裡，樹冠遮蔽了視界，俄軍炮兵難以支援前進中的步兵，波軍才得以在黃昏時仍守住樹林與格羅霍夫至戈茨瓦夫克公路。互補的火器是普拉德辛斯基改良的康格里夫火箭，它以少量火藥推送火箭彈，在格羅霍夫打亂了俄軍騎兵衝鋒，同時也被部署在華沙防線上。九月保衛華沙時，維斯瓦河右岸的野戰工事與碉堡群成為爭奪焦點，第五十四號碉堡即在其中，最後以炸藥自毀，砲手與彈藥同失。俄軍除野砲外，還有大量團屬砲與攻城砲配合攻勢，並在華沙外圍建立砲兵陣地。波軍的砲彈多數靠王國兵工廠與華沙軍械庫供應，砲管與銅料的來源有限，供應線一斷，格羅霍夫那樣的火力密度就難以維持。
kitsEn: The field gun was not a secondary item in this war but the backbone of the Polish army. The artillery of the Congress Kingdom was built on bronze smoothbore pieces: four-, six-, eight- and twelve-pounder field guns with three- and five-pounder howitzers, backed by brigade guns, and the total strength was estimated in the hundreds of pieces when the rising began. At the battle of Olszynka Grochowska on 25 February 1831 the Poles had about thirty-six to forty thousand men and one hundred and fifteen guns against roughly sixty thousand Russians with one hundred and seventy-eight guns, so that the Russians had the advantage in density of fire; but the Polish lines were set in the woods east of Grochów, the crowns of the trees screened the field of view, and the Russian artillery had great difficulty supporting infantry that was advancing, which allowed the Poles to hold both the woods and the road from Grochów to Gocławek at dusk. The complement to the guns was the Congreve rocket improved by Prądzyński, pushed by a small charge of propellant, which disrupted the Russian cavalry at Grochów and was also deployed along the Warsaw defences. In the defence of Warsaw in September the field works and redoubt line on the right bank of the Vistula became the focus of the fighting, redoubt number fifty-four being one of them; it was finally destroyed with its ammunition by explosive charge, the gunners and the shells going with it. On the Russian side the field guns were supported by large numbers of brigade and siege pieces and by batteries established around Warsaw. The Polish ammunition supply came chiefly from the arsenal of the kingdom and the depots of Warsaw; the supply of tubes and copper was limited, and once the supply line was cut, a density of fire like that of Grochów could no longer be maintained.
tactics: 波軍的戰術核心是守點與短促的反擊。一八三〇年十一月廿九日先奪軍火庫再取總督府，把一場政變變成了全城起義；十一月底至十二月初，起義軍驅逐俄軍據點，恢復國民軍旗號，並在全國各地接管行政與要塞。華沙的防禦以維斯瓦河右岸為骨架，據點之間以野戰塹壕連接，炮兵按射界分為若干獨立炮兵群，與步兵的配合以一次齊射即換位為原則；這在格羅霍夫的林地裡被證明極為有效，因為俄軍的密集隊形在林緣被迫展開，齊射的效益倍增。騎兵方面，波軍的戰鐮隊與輕騎兵不負責正面衝鋒，而是以長矛與馬刀打擊俄軍側翼與炮兵牽引隊。一八三一年二月格羅霍夫之後，戰局轉為惡劣天氣下的消耗：波軍多次在據點之間長距離機動，糧秣靠民間運輸維持，許多據點因彈藥告罄而放棄；指揮層多次拒絕追擊撤退的俄軍，被後世批評為放棄戰機。九月，帕斯克維奇集中數個軍團包圍華沙，先拔外圍據點再逼近城牆，防守方以逐點抵抗消耗攻方，城破之後仍以模德林與扎莫希奇等要塞繼續抵抗到十月。
tacticsEn: The core of Polish method was to hold points and to counterattack briefly. On 29 November 1830 the arsenal was taken first and the viceroy's palace second, which turned a mutiny into an uprising of the whole city; from late November to early December the insurgents drove out the Russian garrisons, restored the national flag and took over the administration and the fortresses in various parts of the country. The defence of Warsaw rested on the right bank of the Vistula, with the redoubts joined by field entrenchments, and the artillery was divided into separate groups according to its fields of fire. Its cooperation with the infantry followed the rule of a single salvo followed by a change of position, and in the woods at Grochów this proved extremely effective, because the dense Russian formations were forced to deploy on the edge of the forest and the effect of the salvo was multiplied. In the cavalry the scythemen and light horse did not charge frontally but used lances and sabres against the flanks of the Russians and against the teams drawing their guns. After Grochów in February 1831 the war turned into an attritional struggle in bad weather: the Polish army made long moves between its positions, subsisted on civilian transport, and abandoned many points for want of ammunition; the command repeatedly refused to pursue the withdrawing Russians, and was later criticised for letting opportunities go. In September Paskevich concentrated several corps around Warsaw, taking the outer works one by one before pressing on the walls, and the defenders answered with point-by-point resistance that wore down the attacker; after the city fell, resistance continued at Modlin and Zamość into October.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。起義始於一八三〇年十一月廿九日，以一八三一年十月二十一日完全結束，歷時約十個月。開戰之初波軍在首都與西部可用兵力約四萬人，但擴充主要靠徵召，到一八三一年春，作戰部隊與地方武裝的總數仍不到正規軍的三分之一；俄軍方面，迪比奇首批投入的部隊在三萬至五萬之間，帕斯克維奇接手後全軍擴至十萬以上，另有借道普魯士追擊的單位。一八三一年二月二十五日格羅霍夫戰役，波軍約三萬六千至四萬人、一百一十五門砲，俄軍約六萬人、一百七十八門砲；俄軍傷亡約九千五百人，波軍傷亡從六千九百到一萬二千人不等，波軍守住華沙卻未追擊。九月六日瓦拉區的蘇維尼堡壘淪陷，七日克魯科維茨基同意投降，華沙隨後被接管，軍隊的抵抗延續到十月，其間莫德林與扎莫希奇兩座要塞仍在抵抗。戰後追捕極為嚴酷：大批起義者被處死、發配西伯利亞或流亡國外，華沙大學與維爾紐斯大學被關閉，議會與憲章一併廢除。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The rising began on 29 November 1830 and ended completely on 21 October 1831, a matter of about ten months. At the outset the Polish army had about forty thousand men available in the capital and the west, but expansion depended on conscription, and by the spring of 1831 the regular troops and the local bands together still numbered less than a third of the regular army; on the Russian side the troops committed by Diebitsch at first were between thirty and fifty thousand, and after Paskevich took over the whole army was expanded beyond a hundred thousand, with additional units pursuing across Prussian territory. At the battle of Grochów on 25 February 1831 the Poles had about thirty-six to forty thousand men and one hundred and fifteen guns against roughly sixty thousand Russians with one hundred and seventy-eight guns; Russian casualties came to about nine thousand five hundred, and Polish casualties ranged from six thousand nine hundred to twelve thousand. Warsaw was saved, but not pursued. The redoubt of Sowiński at Wola fell on 6 September, Krukowiecki agreed to capitulate on the seventh, Warsaw was then taken over, and resistance continued into October, with Modlin and Zamość still holding out. The reprisals afterwards were severe: large numbers of the insurgents were executed, deported to Siberia or scattered into exile, the universities of Warsaw and Vilnius were closed, and the Diet and the charter were abolished.
cause: 起因是俄國對波蘭的統治方式逐步收緊。一八一五年維也納會議把波蘭設為以沙皇為國王的自治王國，附有憲法、議會、軍隊與法庭，亞歷山大一世時期尚存出版自由；一八一九年新聞自由被廢、出版審查開始，共濟會被禁，青年學生與軍官之間的地下社團在浪漫主義與愛國主義的鼓舞下迅速擴張。康斯坦丁大公自一八一九年出任總督後，撤廢社團與愛國組織，清除軍政職位上的波蘭人，與波軍的摩擦日增。一八二〇年代後期，尼古拉一世即位並準備對波蘭推行更嚴厲的保守政策，外界普遍預期他會收回憲章與自治。一八三〇年夏天法國七月革命與比利時革命接連爆發，尼古拉一世打算用波蘭軍隊去鎮壓歐洲的革命，這明顯違反波蘭憲法，軍校學員與中尉遂決定先發制人。十一月廿八日至廿九日連夜開會定計，廿九日夜起事成功，華沙在一夜之間改旗易幟，起義由首都擴展為全國性的戰爭。
causeEn: The cause was the steady tightening of Russian rule over Poland. The Congress of Vienna in 1815 had made Poland an autonomous kingdom with a king who was the tsar, and with a constitution, a Diet, an army and courts, and under Alexander I there was still freedom of the press; in 1819 freedom of the press was abolished and censorship introduced, freemasonry was banned, and the secret societies that had formed among students and junior officers expanded rapidly under the encouragement of romanticism and patriotism. Constantine, appointed viceroy in 1819, dissolved the societies and patriotic organisations, removed Poles from positions of military and civil command, and the friction with the Polish army grew. In the later 1820s Nicholas I came to the throne intending to impose a far more reactionary policy on Poland, and it was widely expected that he would withdraw the charter and the autonomy. In the summer of 1830 the July Revolution in France and the Belgian Revolution broke out one after the other, and Nicholas intended to use the Polish army to suppress the revolutions in western Europe, a clear violation of the Polish constitution, so the cadets and lieutenants resolved to strike first. Meetings were held on the night of 28 and 29 November to fix the plan, the rising succeeded on the night of the 29th, Warsaw changed flags within a single night, and what had begun in the capital spread into a national war.
impact: 起義失敗的直接後果是波蘭國家的消亡。一八三二年沙皇頒布《王國有機法案》，把波蘭議會、憲法與軍隊一併廢除，華沙降為駐軍城市，華沙大學與維爾紐斯大學關閉；大批知識階層與軍官遭到系統性清除，數萬人流亡，成為此後半個世紀「民族流浪者」群體的來源，一八三〇、六三、六八年的三次起義都被後人串成一條線。對俄羅斯本身，這場戰爭是一個教訓：此後皇帝不再倚靠波蘭人作為西部屏障，波蘭領地被改劃為帝國的西部邊防區，華沙成為帝國邊軍的重鎮，波蘭問題自此被納入俄國內政，直到第一次世界大戰才重新成為國際議題。對西歐，十一月起義與法國、比利時的革命同時發生卻得到完全不同的待遇，讓波蘭人對英法的同情而無行動長期不滿，這份怨望在十九世紀末成為波蘭政治中的固定敘事。軍事上留下的技術遺產更為長久：普拉德辛斯基設計的華沙城防與野戰砲兵配置，以及格羅霍夫所示範的林地遮蔽加短程齊射，此後被俄軍與歐陸各國反覆研究；而大規模動員民間武裝的經驗，也預示了幾十年後各國總動員的走向。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the defeat was the disappearance of the Polish state. In 1832 the tsar issued the Organic Statute, abolishing the Diet, the constitution and the army of Poland together; Warsaw was reduced to a garrison city, the universities of Warsaw and Vilnius were closed; the intellectual and officer corps of the country was systematically purged, tens of thousands went into exile and became the source of the wandering nation of the following half century, and the risings of 1830, 1863 and 1868 were afterwards strung together into a single thread. For Russia itself the war was a lesson: the tsar no longer relied on the Poles as a western buffer, Polish territory was reorganised as a western defence zone of the empire, Warsaw became a major garrison of the imperial frontier armies, and the Polish question was henceforth internal to Russia, returning to the international agenda only at the outbreak of the First World War. In western Europe, the November Uprising happened at the same moment as the revolutions in France and Belgium and was treated entirely differently, leaving a lasting Polish resentment against British and French sympathy without action that became a fixed theme in Polish politics by the end of the nineteenth century. The technical legacy was longer-lived still: the Warsaw defences and field artillery dispositions designed by Prądzyński, and the combination of woodland screening and short-range salvo demonstrated at Grochów, were afterwards studied repeatedly by Russian and continental armies; and the experience of mobilising large bodies of popular armed men foreshadowed the general mobilisations of the decades to come.
result: 波蘭的抵抗在實質上止於一八三一年的華沙。帕斯克維奇完成對華沙的外圍封鎖後逐點攻破工事；九月六日蘇維尼將軍指揮的沃拉堡壘淪陷，防守該處的波軍幾乎全滅；七日總司令克魯科維茨基簽署投降書，其後政府更迭，馬瓦霍夫斯基一度重整，但最終由帕克主持談判，華沙於九月下旬至十月間陷落。十月裡莫德林與扎莫希奇兩座要塞仍在抵抗，莫德林至十月底才投降，此後有組織的抵抗全面瓦解。沙皇隨即廢除波蘭憲法、關閉大學、清洗軍官與知識分子，起義領袖或被處死、或被判流放西伯利亞，參與者被沒收產業或充軍；戰時由議會通過的憲章被改得面目全非，最後連議會本身也一併取消。從裝備的結果看，同樣可以確定：野砲守住了格羅霍夫的林地，卻沒能守住華沙。波軍以一百一十五門砲對一百七十八門砲的劣勢在第一場大戰就已顯形，而彈藥與銅料來源的受限，使這種劣勢在半年內無法逆轉。
resultEn: Polish resistance effectively ended at Warsaw in 1831. Having completed the investment of the city, Paskevich took the outer works one by one; on 6 September the redoubt of Wola held by General Sowiński fell and its Polish garrison was virtually annihilated; on the seventh the commander in chief Krukowiecki signed the capitulation, the government was then reshuffled and Małachowski made a last effort to reorganise, but the final negotiations were conducted by Pac, and Warsaw fell between the last days of September and October. In October Modlin and Zamość still held out, Modlin not surrendering until the end of the month, after which organised resistance collapsed altogether. The tsar then abolished the Polish constitution, closed the universities and purged officers and intellectuals; the leaders of the rising were executed or sentenced to exile in Siberia, and the participants lost their property or were conscripted; the charter the Diet had passed during the war was rewritten beyond recognition and finally even the Diet was abolished. The same can be said of the equipment: the field gun held the woods at Grochów, but it could not hold Warsaw. The disadvantage of a hundred and fifteen guns against a hundred and seventy-eight had been visible in the first major battle, and the restriction of ammunition and of copper made it impossible to reverse within half a year.
